messages:
maria: Quick travel q: flying to Berlin next week — early morning (6am) or red-eye? Also what's best for sleep: window + neck pillow or noise-canceling earbuds? any snack recs? :airplane:
kevin: red-eye if you can actually sleep on planes. window for leaning, + eye mask. bring compression socks. :zzz:
sophie: early morning if you need to be somewhat functional on arrival. stretch + protein bar. pretzels are meh. also pick row with less foot traffic (avoid galley).
devon: i do aisle + amber neck pillow (lets me get up). eSIM worked fine in EU last month — cheaper than pocket wifi for solo. @maria check roaming plan
anjali: pro tip: download podcasts + a couple of short guided-sleep tracks. and an empty water bottle to fill after security. also bring a hoodie for warmth.
travels-bot: Reminder: submit travel expense docs within 14 days. :memo:
kevin: seat: avoid seats by the bathrooms. row 20 on LH was loud. snacks: trail mix + something salty
sophie: if you want a nap, book window + request 'wing' seat so you can brace. for tight connections, go aisle.
maria: awesome — tallying votes. Poll: what's your pick? 1) red-eye 2) early morning 3) never flying red-eye — reply with emoji :one: :two: :three:
devon: Voted :one: but only on transatlantic
anjali: :two: if there's a demo day the next morning
kevin: Also: pack these small things: ```- compression socks
- eye mask
- small power bank
- empty bottle
- ibuprofen```
sophie: Pro-tip for hotel: request early check-in in advance, otherwise use hotel gym to freshen up. also check plug adapter: EU type C. bring a tiny power strip :plug:
maria: @kevin @sophie you two are lifesavers. will pack the ibuprofen. See y'all at the offsite meetup? :coffee:
devon: I'll be there — meet at baggage claim at Terminal 2? Flight lands 08:20.
maria: ok added. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
